# Beaconstac

Beaconstac provides a platform for creating and managing QR codes and beacons, enabling businesses to engage customers through proximity marketing and track analytics.

Category: Marketing. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/beaconstac/.

## Actions

- **Create Place**: Create a new place for location-based assets.
- **Create QR Template**: Create a new qr code template.
- **Create Tag**: Create a new tag for organizing qr codes and other objects.
- **Create User**: Create a new user.
- **Delete QR Code**: Delete a qr code by its id.
- **Delete QR Code Template**: Delete a qr code template by its id.
- **Delete Tag**: Delete a tag by its id.
- **Get Period Overview**: Get period overview analytics for products including counts, impressions, and conversion percentage.
- **Get Product Overview**: Get analytics overview for a specified product type over a given time interval.
- **List Bulk QR Code Collections**: List bulk qr code collections.
- **List Organizations**: List organizations.
- **List Places**: List your places.
- **List QR Templates**: List all qr code templates in your account.
- **List Tags**: List all tags with optional filtering and pagination.
- **List Users**: List all users with optional filtering, searching, ordering, and pagination.
- **Retrieve QR Code**: Retrieve details of a specific qr code by its id.
- **Retrieve User**: Retrieve the details of an existing user by id.
- **Update Place**: Update the specified place by id.
- **Update QR Code**: Update an existing qr code by its id.
- **Update Tag**: Update an existing tag by its id.
- **Update User**: Update an existing user.
